scripts.lint: python -m ruff check backend scripts && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: python -m mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/app && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.format: python -m ruff format backend scripts && npm run format --workspace frontend
scripts.format:check: python -m ruff format --check backend scripts && npm run format:check --workspace frontend
scripts.eval:smoke: python -m app.cli eval run --purpose smoke --manifest benchmark/manifests/smoke.json
